title: GoogleCLIOptions
description: Native Gemini CLI arguments used by Captain's Google CLI runtime.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: Composed prompt text written to Gemini standard input.

model.title: Model
model.description: Gemini model identifier used for the request.

approvalMode.title: Approval mode
approvalMode.description: Gemini tool-approval posture translated from Captain policy.

outputFormat.title: Output format
outputFormat.description: Format used for Gemini CLI output.

x-captain-option.note: Captain requires stream-json for typed event parsing.

debug.title: Debug
debug.description: Whether Gemini CLI debug logging is enabled.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not expose Gemini CLI debug logging.

promptFlag.title: Prompt flag
promptFlag.description: Prompt text supplied directly by the --prompt flag.

x-captain-option.note: Captain writes the composed prompt to standard input.

promptInteractive.title: Interactive prompt
promptInteractive.description: Initial prompt followed by an interactive Gemini session.

x-captain-option.note: Captain runs Gemini headlessly for one request.

skipTrust.title: Skip trust check
skipTrust.description: Whether Gemini skips workspace trust validation.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not bypass Gemini workspace trust checks.

worktree.title: Worktree
worktree.description: Whether Gemini creates and runs in a Git worktree.

x-captain-option.note: Captain executes in the working directory supplied by its context.

sandbox.title: Sandbox
sandbox.description: Whether Gemini enables its native sandbox, optionally with a sandbox image.

x-captain-option.note: Captain rejects native sandbox mode for the Gemini CLI adapter.

yolo.title: YOLO mode
yolo.description: Whether Gemini automatically approves every tool action.

x-captain-option.note: Captain maps explicit bypass and dontAsk policies through --approval-mode yolo.

policy.title: Policy files
policy.description: Policy files applied by Gemini CLI.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not expose Gemini policy files.

adminPolicy.title: Admin policy
adminPolicy.description: Additional administrator policy files applied by Gemini CLI.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not expose Gemini administrator policy files.

acp.title: ACP mode
acp.description: Whether Gemini runs as an Agent Client Protocol server.

x-captain-option.note: Captain integrates with Gemini through stream-json rather than ACP.

experimentalAcp.title: Experimental ACP mode
experimentalAcp.description: Whether Gemini enables experimental Agent Client Protocol behavior.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not use Gemini's experimental ACP server.

allowedMcpServerNames.title: Allowed MCP servers
allowedMcpServerNames.description: MCP server names allowed to connect in ACP mode.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not configure Gemini ACP MCP servers.

allowedTools.title: Allowed tools
allowedTools.description: Deprecated list of tools allowed to execute without confirmation.

x-captain-option.note: Gemini marks this flag deprecated; Captain rejects tool policies the adapter cannot represent.

extensions.title: Extensions
extensions.description: Gemini CLI extensions enabled for the session.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not select Gemini CLI extensions.

listExtensions.title: List extensions
listExtensions.description: Whether Gemini lists installed extensions and exits.

x-captain-option.note: Captain executes requests rather than extension discovery.

resume.title: Resume session
resume.description: Session index or latest selector resumed by Gemini CLI.

x-captain-option.note: Gemini resumes by local session index rather than Captain's stable session ID.

sessionFile.title: Session file
sessionFile.description: Path to a Gemini session file loaded for execution.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not load Gemini session files directly.

sessionId.title: Session ID
sessionId.description: Explicit Gemini session identifier selected for execution.

x-captain-option.note: Captain's Gemini registry does not advertise resume support.

listSessions.title: List sessions
listSessions.description: Whether Gemini lists stored sessions for the current project.

x-captain-option.note: Captain performs session discovery outside request execution.

deleteSession.title: Delete session
deleteSession.description: Stored Gemini session index deleted before exit.

x-captain-option.note: Captain never deletes provider sessions as part of execution.

includeDirectories.title: Included directories
includeDirectories.description: Additional workspace directories included in the Gemini session.

x-captain-option.note: Captain rejects additional directories for the Gemini CLI adapter.

screenReader.title: Screen reader mode
screenReader.description: Whether interactive output is optimized for screen readers.

x-captain-option.note: Captain consumes machine-readable output and does not expose terminal accessibility flags.

rawOutput.title: Raw output
rawOutput.description: Whether terminal control sequences are preserved in streamed output.

x-captain-option.note: Captain parses structured JSON events rather than raw terminal output.

acceptRawOutputRisk.title: Accept raw output risk
acceptRawOutputRisk.description: Explicit acknowledgement required before raw output is enabled.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not enable raw terminal output.

help.title: Help
help.description: Whether Gemini prints command help and exits.

x-captain-option.note: Captain executes requests rather than CLI help.

version.title: Version
version.description: Whether Gemini prints its version and exits.

x-captain-option.note: Captain resolves the installed CLI version outside request execution.
